kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.summary: Rates have climbed more than a full percentage point since the U.S. war against Iran started.

wire.title: The economic squeeze is pushing up poverty rates for older adults
wire.summary: Despite lower poverty overall, the rate for seniors has been steadily rising in recent years. A new AARP survey sheds light on how those over 50 are struggling in the crucial time before retirement.

wire.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit amid underlying tensions
wire.summary: On Thursday, the two leaders will hold meetings where Trump and Xi are expected to talk about artificial intelligence, rare earths, trade and geopolitics such as Iran and Taiwan.

wire.summary: A judge has ordered that the Trump administration restore journalists' access to White House. And, Tucker Carlson sits down with Morning Edition 's Steve Inskeep for a Newsmakers interview.

wire.summary: In Liberia, joint financial planning boosted cash aid's benefits. It also had an unexpected consequence for some families.

wire.title: The Education Dept. hasn't been dismantled. It's become more inefficient, staff say
wire.summary: Education staff are being scattered across several other federal agencies. Despite the Trump administration's claims, employees say it's adding bureaucracy and making it harder to serve students.

wire.title: eBay bans airbag sales as concerns about faulty or counterfeit parts rise
wire.summary: eBay became the latest online retailer to ban the sale of airbags and many of their components. Aftermarket parts can be risky if they turn out to be fake or defective.

wire.title: Warren demands Trump officials explain removing a ban on interference in census data
wire.summary: Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren asked Trump officials to explain why the Census Bureau's parent agency cut a ban on political interference from its scientific integrity policy, as NPR first reported.

wire.title: These 6 charts show how NIH research funding has been reshaped under Trump

wire.summary: The investigations by attorneys general follow a recent bankruptcy filing in the face of civil lawsuits, falling revenues, and impending debt payments.

wire.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
wire.summary: CNN, Politico and MS NOW were allowed back into the White House after some of their staff were earlier turned away.

wire.title: Rogue OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website in world first
wire.summary: Australia criticised OpenAI for taking "too long" to tell them about the breach which happened in June.

wire.title: Why did an OpenAI system hack Australia's health system - and can it be stopped in the future?
wire.summary: News that an automated AI agent hacked a government IT system raises big questions about regulating the tech.

wire.title: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
wire.summary: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

wire.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
wire.summary: The military says its soldiers inflicted casualties as fears grow of a resumption of a full-blown civil war.

wire.summary: The suspect is alleged to have been an accessory to murder at the Stalag 326 camp, where tens of thousands of Soviet PoWs died.
